verses.text: A song of ascents. LORD, I’ve cried out to you from the depths.
Lord, hear my voice. Listen closely when I beg you for help.
LORD, if you kept track of every sin, Lord, who could stand?
But you have forgiveness, and that’s why people fear you.
I wait for the LORD. Everything in me waits. I put my hope in his word.
I want the Lord more than night guards want the morning, more than night guards want the morning.
Israel, put your hope in the LORD. He’s full of faithful love, and he has more than enough power to redeem.
He’ll redeem Israel from all their sins.
